name: PureScript
typeSystem: Static, strong, Hindley-Milner-based with type classes, higher-kinded types, and row polymorphism (extensible records) - effectively a stricter, JavaScript-targeting cousin of Haskell.
runtime: Compiles to readable JavaScript, with strict (not lazy) evaluation by default, unlike Haskell.

runtimes.name: Compile to JavaScript
runtimes.role: The reference backend; emits clean, human-readable JavaScript modules.

concurrencyModel: Effects are tracked in the type system via the Effect and Aff types (synchronous and asynchronous effect monads); concurrency itself follows the host JavaScript engine's event loop.

codeExample.caption: Hello, World! plus a recursive factorial
codeExample.source:
module Main where

import Prelude
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)

fact :: Int -> Int
fact 0 = 1
fact n = n * fact (n - 1)

main :: Effect Unit
main = logShow (fact 10)
